hints.title: Determine Square Cut Size
hints.text: The largest square cut from rectangle [l, w] has side length min(l, w).

hints.title: Track Maximum Side Length
hints.text: Scan rectangles maintaining the maximum min(l, w) seen so far.

hints.title: Count Rectangles Matching Max
hints.text: When a new strictly larger side is found, reset count to 1; if equal, increment count.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space single pass tracks max side and occurrence counter.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes a clean single pass tracking max side and tally.
